title: Law on Remuneration and Rights of the Cadre Members of the General Presidency of Legislation Affairs — Article 10
text: The legislative plan of action shall contain the list of legislative that can be formulated within the planned time period, names of the directors of plan provision and the time for its presentation to the Council of Ministers.
law_title: Law on Remuneration and Rights of the Cadre Members of the General Presidency of Legislation Affairs
